The Pyramid Overlord has risen! The pyramid's last guardian. We will need every banner we have.
The Curtain Wall protects our city. It makes our defenders stronger, but siege engines and artillery can break it. Keep it upgraded and repaired.
Glyph Reading. This one matters. plus 25 percent tech fragment production. The ruin's symbols begin to make sense.
Iron Warrior. Iron swords and round shields; the backbone of the hill forts. Infantry hold the line and beat mounted troops, but ranged troops cut them down.

The Castle Keep is the heart of our settlement. Its level is the ceiling for every other building, so when something can't be upgraded any higher, raise this first. A strong hall also prepares us for the next age.
The Legion Fort trains our troops. Each level unlocks stronger units and lets you train bigger batches at once.

Laser Trooper. Directed-energy rifles; instant hits. Ranged troops strike first and beat infantry, but fast riders can run them down. They can shoot down aircraft. Research Directed Energy to train them.
The Training Complex trains our troops. Each level unlocks stronger units and lets you train bigger batches at once.

We will rise through ten ages, from stone to the stars. To advance, finish the age's key research, dig fragments at the Dig Site, and raise the Chieftain Hall. Every new age brings new buildings, troops and wonders.
The Fabrication Hub turns out advanced alloys. You'll need it to build armoured vehicles and the great machines of later ages.
Pathfinding. plus 10 percent march speed, +2 vision. It builds on Domestication.
Food fields. Send your gatherers to the closest one, and they'll carry the harvest home.
The Iron-Tool Quarry gives us stone for walls, halls and upgrades. Higher levels mean more stone every hour.

Orbital Battery. Calls lances of energy down from orbit. Siege engines break enemy walls. Keep them behind your lines, because they are weak up close. They smash enemy walls. Research Orbital Bombardment to train them.
The Carpentry Works cuts our timber. Almost everything we build needs wood, so keep it busy and upgrade it often.
Heavy Cavalry. Worth our time. Unlocks Cataphracts.
The University is where we study. Research gives permanent bonuses, unlocks new troops, and leads us to the next age.
The Timber Yard cuts our timber. Almost everything we build needs wood, so keep it busy and upgrade it often.
Automatic Weapons. This one matters. Unlocks Machine-Gun Teams.
The Archaeologists' Guild digs alien fragments out of the ruins. Fragments are the key to every new age, so upgrade it and never let it sit idle.
Internal Combustion. A wise study. Required to advance to the Modern Age. This is a key discovery for reaching the next age. It builds on Railways and Artillery Science and Mass Production.
That's you! Pick an avatar from your heroes, write a bio, and see how you rank. Other rulers see this card when they tap your banner.
The Precursor Archive digs alien fragments out of the ruins. Fragments are the key to every new age, so upgrade it and never let it sit idle.
Story quests, daily tasks and achievements. Claim whatever shows a red badge: resources, speed-ups and gems.
The Air Base builds and services our aircraft. Planes strike armour and artillery from above, but watch for anti-air.

Attack Helicopter. Tank-hunting helicopter gunship. Aircraft strike from above and hit armour and artillery hard. Anti-air troops are their worst enemy. They can hover over any terrain. Research Rotorcraft to train them.
The Horreum raises how much we can store and hides part of it from raiders. Upgrade it before you save up for something big.
Man-at-Arms. Mail-clad halberdiers who hold castle breaches. Infantry hold the line and beat mounted troops, but ranged troops cut them down.
The Alien Forge turns out advanced alloys. You'll need it to build armoured vehicles and the great machines of later ages.
The Academy is where we study. Research gives permanent bonuses, unlocks new troops, and leads us to the next age.
The pyramid's shield is down! Its defenders are exposed. Strike now.
Heroes level up too. They gain experience in every battle they lead, and each level makes their specialty stronger. Tomes of Tactics give them a quick boost.
Castle Masonry. This one matters. plus 40 percent wall hit points, plus 10 percent wall defence.
You're ready, chief! Follow the quests and I'll be right beside you. Here's a war chest to begin our legend!

Steam Power. A wise study. Required to advance to the Industrial Age. This is a key discovery for reaching the next age. It builds on Cannon Casting and Plate Cuirass and Bastion Fortresses and Scientific Method.
The Autonomous Mine produces metal. Stronger troops, gear and late buildings all need metal, so upgrade it as soon as you can.
Everything in our empire levels up. Each upgrade makes a building stronger, and the Chieftain Hall's level is the ceiling for all the others. Tap any building and I'll tell you what it does.
The Flint Pit gives us stone for walls, halls and upgrades. Higher levels mean more stone every hour.
Plasma Weapons. Worth our time. Unlocks Plasma Lancers.
The Grain Stores raises how much we can store and hides part of it from raiders. Upgrade it before you save up for something big.

The Hill-Fort Hall is the heart of our settlement. Its level is the ceiling for every other building, so when something can't be upgraded any higher, raise this first. A strong hall also prepares us for the next age.
Quick actions sit on top, and every screen is listed below. Tap your ruler card to see your profile.
The Herbalists' Hall saves our defenders. Troops who fall at home are wounded instead of killed, up to its capacity. Heal them here and they fight again.
